title: 多语言语音识别中的Token合并：跨模型规模与微调的系统研究
summary: 本文系统评估了Whisper模型族在16种语言和3种模型规模下的Token合并技术，并测试其与DoRA微调的交互。结果表明，Token合并能在几乎不损失转录准确率的情况下提升计算效率，且微调后依然有效，是多语言语音识别部署提速降本的高实用方法。
summary_en: This paper systematically evaluates token merging on the Whisper model family across sixteen languages and three model sizes, and tests its interaction with DoRA fine-tuning on low-resource languages. Results show token merging improves computational efficiency with almost no accuracy loss, and remains effective after fine-tuning, making multilingual speech recognition faster and cheaper to deploy.
